description: Mapeamento das Queimadas do ano de 2015 - Região Oeste, Norte e Nordeste da Bahia - 1:120.000 - VETOR - 2015 – INEMA. is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Mapeamento das cicatrizes dos incêndios que ocorreram no período de seca (Outubro à Dezembro) no estado da Bahia, no ano de 2015, a fim de contribuir com insumos para o projeto Operação Bahia Sem Fogo (OBSF). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
